core: Regulation of mesoderm and heart morphogenesis
name: Mesoderm and heart morphogenesis including pericardium and coronary vessels
rationale: All members regulate mesoderm-derived heart morphogenesis, and the pericardium, coronary vasculogenesis and cardiac vascular smooth muscle members separate it from the gastrulation, secondary heart field and ventricular/endocardial confusables.

core: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signaling to Ras
name: NT-3/TrkC receptor signaling via Ras-activating adaptors
rationale: Members are NTF3-NTRK3 signaling through RAS, PI3K and PLCG1 plus Frs2/ARMS adaptor-mediated Ras activation, distinguishing it from the NGF/TrkA, TrkB and p38/ERK5 confusables.

core: Golgi vesicle budding, tethering and targeting
name: COPI and intra-Golgi vesicle budding, tethering and targeting
rationale: Members cover COPI vesicle budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic and Golgi vesicle tethering/targeting, whereas confusables centre on COPII ER export or Rab/ARF regulation.

name: CDP-dependent synthesis of cardiolipin, phosphatidylglycerol and phosphatidylcholine
rationale: All members are CDP-diacylglycerol or CDP-choline routes to cardiolipin, PG and PC (with CL/PG remodeling), unlike confusables built on PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or other phospholipid remodeling and catabolism.

core: Purine nucleotide synthesis and nucleoside triphosphate turnover
qualifier: thiopurine metabolism and NTP pool sanitization
name: De novo purine synthesis, thiopurine metabolism and NTP sanitization
rationale: Members combine de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis with NUDT-mediated nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and TPMT/azathioprine thiopurine handling, which separates it from salvage/catabolism and antiviral-drug confusables.

core: Collagen and elastic fibre extracellular matrix
qualifier: synthesis, crosslinking and regulation of collagen metabolism
name: Collagen and elastic fibre synthesis, crosslinking and regulation
rationale: Members concern collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and fibril regulation and elastic fibre assembly and elastin turnover, while confusables emphasise basement membrane, MMP-driven collagen degradation or proteoglycans.

core: Oxidative and nitrosative stress-induced cell death
qualifier: with mitochondrial respiration control and ferroptosis
name: Oxidative stress-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis with mitochondrial respiration control
rationale: Members are responses to peroxide, nitric oxide and ischemia regulating intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis together with regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and respiration, a combination no confusable has (they lack either the stress-death or the respiration arm).

name: O-fucose and O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins
rationale: Members are O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of pre-Notch EGF repeats and TSR domains (including B3GALTL/Peters-plus), distinct from Hedgehog processing, N-glycosylation and heparan sulfate confusables.

core: Activity-dependent neuronal transcription via CREB and MECP2
name: Activity-dependent CREB and MECP2 transcription via CaMK and PKA
rationale: Members link synaptic calcium/CaMK and cAMP/PKA signaling to CREB phosphorylation, NPAS4 and MECP2-regulated neuronal genes, whereas confusables lack MECP2 or lack the CREB/PKA arm.

qualifier: ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4 through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K
name: ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4 signaling through SHC1, GRB2 and PI3K
rationale: All members are ERBB2, ERBB3 or ERBB4 dimer signaling via SHC1, GRB2 or PI3K, separating it from EGFR-centred, ERBB4 nuclear/downregulation and other ERBB2-effector confusables.

qualifier: global-genome and transcription-coupled recognition and incision
name: Global-genome and transcription-coupled nucleotide excision repair
rationale: Members are GG-NER and TC-NER damage recognition, incision and repair of UV pyrimidine dimers, while confusables are translesion synthesis, UV responses or GG-NER gap filling.

name: NRF2 and AKT-regulated FOXO stress-response transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programs and AKT-controlled FOXO localization and transcription of stress and death genes, whereas confusables are ER/integrated stress responses or NRF2/p53 metabolic regulation without FOXO.

name: De novo pyrimidine synthesis and pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism
rationale: Members are de novo pyrimidine/UTP synthesis plus pyrimidine and deoxynucleotide catabolism, distinct from purine de novo synthesis, deoxynucleotide biosynthesis/salvage and NTP-hydrolysis confusables.

name: Misfolded protein triage via aggrephagy, selective autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through aggresome/aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, pexophagy/reticulophagy and ERAD regulation, unlike chaperonin folding, stress granule and proteasomal-ubiquitination confusables.

core: Two-pore-domain potassium channels and resting potential
name: Two-pore K+ channels, resting potential and acid/sour sensing
rationale: Members are the K2P channel families setting resting membrane potential plus acid-pH responses and sour taste with TRP channels, while confusables are Ca2+-activated or ATP-sensitive K+ channels or pain/thermal TRP sensing.

qualifier: fibroblast, focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix
name: Fibroblast migration, focal adhesion and fibronectin matrix assembly
rationale: Members cover fibroblast migration, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly, syndecan/fibronectin matrix and collagen/TGF-beta migration modules, whereas confusables emphasise MET/integrin spreading, RHO effectors or smooth muscle adhesion.

core: Autophagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes
qualifier: autophagosome maturation and organelle size control
name: Autophagosome maturation and endolysosomal fusion with organelle size control
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly/maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, phagosomes and MVBs with lysosomes plus endosome/lysosome size, while confusables are selective autophagy, mitophagy or ESCRT/MVB sorting.

name: ATP/NAD energy-carrier homeostasis and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange
rationale: Members span nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, NAD/NADP salvage, phosphocreatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport with its permeabilization/depolarization effects, distinct from nucleoside transport, pyrophosphate and CoA confusables.

qualifier: lipid-modified Hedgehog and Wnt ligand biogenesis
name: Hedgehog signaling and lipid-modified Hedgehog/Wnt ligand biogenesis
rationale: Members cover SMO/GLI Hedgehog signaling plus palmitoylation, autoprocessing and secretion of Hh and Wnt ligands, whereas confusables are DVL/Wnt regulation, prenylation or Wnt/calcium signaling.

qualifier: growth, survival and invasion rather than pigmentation
name: MITF-M-regulated melanocyte growth, survival and invasion genes
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programs for proliferation, apoptosis, metabolism, lysosomes and invasion plus melanocyte proliferation/differentiation, while confusables carry pigmentation, melanin synthesis and UV responses.

name: Pyrimidine (UMP/CMP) nucleotide catabolism and salvage
rationale: Members are catabolism of UMP, CMP, dCMP, dUMP and pyrimidine bases plus UMP salvage, while confusables add dGMP/dTMP and purine deoxynucleoside catabolism.

name: De novo nucleotide synthesis with folate one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members are de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis together with folate/tetrahydrofolate interconversion, the folate arm being absent from every confusable.

name: Chromatin remodeling and ADP-ribosylation at DNA damage and forks
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/remodeling, ADP-ribosylation control and protein recruitment to DNA breaks and reversed forks, while confusables emphasise R-loops, DNA topology and replication-stress responses.

qualifier: germinal center and T follicular helper co-stimulation
name: Germinal center B cell activation and T follicular helper co-stimulation
rationale: Members describe B cell activation, germinal center differentiation, memory B signatures and Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation, distinguishing it from general B cell, B-1 and immune memory confusables.

name: Common gamma-chain cytokine signaling and NK cell development
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling with NK cell proliferation/differentiation, unlike beta-common (IL-3/5), IL-6, IL-10/12 family and T cell activation confusables.
